full_page.content:
1911
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 7
June 30 in N.Y. City
July 1st Met some of my Altar-boys waiting. at Park Ave. & Shonard P1.
June 15 Altar-boys had photo taken 1st time in six years.
Aug. 10 Altar-boys outing to Dobs-Ferry and Mt. Hope.
Aug. 7-12 and 21st to 26th Annual Retreat Visiting Rev. F.F. and BB. much edified at zeal of some of the Altar-boys. Rev. Fr. Antonine conducted same.
Sept. 4 Labor Day Festival.
Sept. 6th opened School with 4.98 following week 5.15
Sept. 12th Two Funerals Margaret Frances and John Doyle. Two Altar boys overcame themselves generously and edifyingly - (A Dempey and C O'Hara) allowing others to "dish them out" under peculiar circumstances. God Bless Them!
Sept. 22 Funeral of Mrs.
Sept. 27 Fr. S. and about 250 boys and girls from school went down to reproduction of Oberamergam Passion Play at Armory- Nearing the Armory, some larger boys acted rudely. During intertainment they redeemed their good name. Some of larger girls were noisy.
Sept. 29th War between Italy and Tripoli.
October 8-22nd Mission by Rev. Fathers Titus and Sylvester, O.M.F.
29 Rt. Rev. Bishop Cusick confirmed 207 in Monastery Church - seven converts.
Nov. 5 1st Meeting called for following Thursday about New Church.
